tool_schemas.name: random-pokemon
tool_schemas.description: Returns a single randomly selected Pokémon from the full catalog; if you provide a seed, the same seed yields the same selection for repeat calls. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if seed is not a string, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED if invocation limits are exceeded. Raises NOT_FOUND only if the catalog contains no selectable Pokémon.

seed.description: Optional random seed for deterministic selection across repeated calls.

tool_schemas.name: random-pokemon-from-region
tool_schemas.description: Returns a single randomly selected Pokémon limited to the specified region. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if region is missing/empty or not a supported region identifier, NOT_FOUND if the region exists but has no selectable Pokémon in the catalog, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED if invocation limits are exceeded. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if the caller is not permitted to access the tool.

region.description: The Pokémon region (e.g., kanto, johto, hoenn, etc.)

tool_schemas.name: random-pokemon-by-type
tool_schemas.description: Returns a single randomly selected Pokémon limited to the specified Pokémon type. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if type is missing/empty or not a supported type identifier, NOT_FOUND if the type exists but has no selectable Pokémon in the catalog, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED if invocation limits are exceeded. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if the caller is not permitted to access the tool.

type.description: The Pokémon type (e.g., fire, water, grass, etc.)

tool_schemas.name: pokemon-query
tool_schemas.description: Resolves a natural-language Pokémon question into an intent and returns the selected Pokémon results for that query while persisting the query session for later analysis. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if query is missing/empty or not a string, QUOTA_EXCEEDED if invocation limits are exceeded, and UNAUTHORIZED if the caller is not permitted to use NL query. Raises NOT_FOUND when the query is well-formed but no Pokémon or knowledge in the catalog matches the resolved intent.

query.description: A natural language query about Pokémon

tool_schemas.name: list-pokemon
tool_schemas.description: Lists Pokémon in the local catalog with optional filtering and pagination. Returns only records the caller is permitted to view. Refuses with VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid filters/pagination and UNAUTHORIZED if the caller lacks access.

q.description: Case-insensitive substring match against name_normalized (and name where available).

national_dex_min.description: Filter to Pokémon with national_dex_number >= this value.

national_dex_max.description: Filter to Pokémon with national_dex_number <= this value.

limit.description: Maximum number of records to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response.

tool_schemas.name: get-pokemon
tool_schemas.description: Fetches a single Pokémon by pokemon_id. Returns NOT_FOUND if the id does not exist (or is not visible to the caller) and UNAUTHORIZED if the caller lacks access.

pokemon_id.description: Primary identifier of the Pokémon record.

tool_schemas.name: update-pokemon
tool_schemas.description: Updates an existing Pokémon record. Supports lifecycle transitions via the status field (active→disabled/deprecated, disabled→active/deprecated; deprecated is terminal). Refuses with VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid transitions or fields, NOT_FOUND if pokemon_id does not exist, and UNAUTHORIZED if the caller cannot modify the catalog.

pokemon_id.description: Primary identifier of the Pokémon record to update.

name_normalized.description: Normalized name used for search/filtering (lowercase, ASCII where applicable).

default_sprite_url.description: Default sprite URL for the Pokémon.

primary_region_id.description: Region identifier for the Pokémon's primary region reference.

status.description: Lifecycle status update. Deprecated is terminal.

tool_schemas.name: list-regions
tool_schemas.description: Lists supported regions with optional filtering and pagination. Refuses with VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid pagination and UNAUTHORIZED if the caller lacks access.

limit.description: Maximum number of records to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response.

tool_schemas.name: list-types
tool_schemas.description: Lists supported Pokémon types with optional filtering and pagination. Refuses with VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid pagination and UNAUTHORIZED if the caller lacks access.

limit.description: Maximum number of records to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response.

metadata.name: Pokémcp
metadata.description: Pokémcp serves randomized Pokémon lookups (global, by region, by type) and answers natural-language Pokémon questions.
